newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice surges to contract highs on cash demand.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice surges to contract highs on cash demand.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed strongly higher in fast trading and new contract highs were set in the nearby three contracts with firm cash markets cited, traders said.
"The cash market continues to advance. The U.S. markets are very strong on export demand and mill demand," a trader said.
The new high in March is $12.10 per cwt, above the previous high of $11.99 set Friday.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 500 contracts, above the 33 traded Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
Rice closed unchanged to 17 cents per cwt higher, with March up 17 at $12.09 per cwt.
